topic: Someone discovers a hidden room in their new house
text: The walls, they whisper of secrets now laid bare. Light spills into crevices once shrouded in darkness. With each step, the floor sighs underfoot, an echo of discovery. I trace the outline of what was hidden, fingers gentle against cool surfaces. The air holds a breath, then exhales, carrying the scent of old parchment and forgotten scents. Here, shadows dance with the light, no longer afraid. In this quiet revelation, there’s a warmth, a quiet understanding that binds this space and all who enter. The room, so long a silent keeper, now shares its stories, one gentle touch at a time.
